query: SELECT (manifest.size + COALESCE(config_blob.size, 0) + COALESCE(layer_size.total_size, 0))::BIGINT AS "manifest_size!" FROM container_registry_manifest manifest LEFT JOIN container_registry_manifest_image image ON image.manifest_digest = manifest.digest LEFT JOIN container_registry_blob config_blob ON config_blob.digest = image.config_blob_digest LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(layer.size), 0)::BIGINT AS total_size FROM container_registry_manifest_layer layer WHERE layer.manifest_digest = manifest.digest) layer_size ON TRUE WHERE manifest.digest = $1;
